correctness.rationale: All pair types, equality cases and mixed point–line extensions are enumerated algebraically. The only subtle noncollinear-pair remaining count has a nonnegative decomposition with a strictly positive t−1 summand. Both point and line cases follow by duality. Shared positivity support supplies an unrestricted-length three-pebble strategy, while rank-three formulas separate all statuses. Nine explicit constructions witness every class; the first program checks their full incidence axioms and atomic extension supports, and the independent symbolic checker matches all nine and 54,944 admissible parameter triples. Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Partial geometries constitute a nontrivial natural class including generalized quadrangles, nets, transversal designs, affine and projective planes, and Steiner-derived incidence systems. Exactly nine theories in an enriched point/line signature is a complete invariant not captured merely by graph degree; sharp rank-three distinguishing sentences and indefinite back-and-forth expose a clean logic/geometry boundary. Classification remains meaningful despite independently unknown full historical priority and no unproven claim about a minimal representative size.
